_meta.sources: PROCUREMENT.md 4.2 quirk vocabulary, 4.3 price formulae, 5-11 catalog
provenance_notes: Armour carries three resistances — ballistic, energy, explosive — added to protection against the matching damage type. No single vest answers the whole field: plate stops bullets and conducts heat, ablative boils a beam away and cracks under a rifle. Carrying a mix is the point (PROCUREMENT.md 8).

Energy weapons overheat in two or three shots and hold a day's charge, not a fight's: you cannot swap a cell mid-firefight the way you swap a magazine. Their damage runs a point below their ballistic equivalents. The trade is that they never need resupplying (PROCUREMENT.md 6).

There is NO free kit. Nothing in this catalog costs zero: a corp fields what it owns (its armoury) and buys the rest with treasury credits. A founding armoury carries a corp into season one; losing it is a management failure, not a case for charity (PROCUREMENT.md 3, ruled).

picks_for names the stat a corp selects that role by: the marksman rifle goes to the best shot in the squad, the scout kit to the best fieldcraft. Deterministic, (proposed), and it is what stops a 5-aim fighter carrying the Whisper.
roles[] is the baseline squad composition every corp fields (PROCUREMENT.md 15.1). Six roles, a spread of bands, and a candidate list per role. Nobody fields two unit types.

armoury_max_tier is the first appearance of locker depth (PROCUREMENT.md 2.2): the Verdant Cradle gets the same 54,000 allowance as everyone and simply does not own tier-4 kit to spend it on. Poverty is modelled as what you own, never as a preference for cheap guns — the allowance is free, so preferring cheap would be incoherent.

doctrines[] are LEANS on that baseline, not replacements for it: a composition bias of a few bodies, an ordered taste in quirks, a mod wishlist, and the order in which the allowance gets spent. ONE source: the armoury page, the document's table and Step 5b-2's AI procurement all read this block.
Prices with price_model 'formula' are DERIVED from constants.pricing and are regenerated and diffed by `arx.cjs regress`. Editing a formula cost by hand will fail the suite.
price_model 'scarcity' = exotica, hand-priced; guarded only by the 3x floor against the dearest formula item.
price_model 'fixed' = mods and consumables, hand-priced; too small and too varied for a formula to price honestly.
Contraband exists as data with no acquisition path until Step 9 (PROCUREMENT.md 11.2).
Identity is the weapon, refinement is the mod, tier is only a shelf: no model appears at more than one tier (PROCUREMENT.md 4.1).
